title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Engagement of Employees and organizational learning
description: The aim of this course is to unlock the Secrets of Employee Engagement and Organisational Knowledge Management.
longDescription: Discover the keys to successful employee engagement initiatives through learning about profiles, action plans, and the role of leadership and culture. Utilize continuous performance management tools to ensure best practices in engagement and design jobs and initiatives that drive engagement. Enhance your knowledge of organisational learning and identify the learning needs of both the organisation and individual. Evaluate different ways in which people learn and learn how to successfully manage knowledge within the organisation. Gain a deep understanding of the fundamentals of organisational knowledge, including successful knowledge management strategies, explicit versus tacit knowledge, knowledge capture and classification, and strategic levers. Master the art of managing knowledge and propel your organisation to the forefront of your industry.
